findings.issue: Starter recipes are created enabled before wizard completion; a fresh daemon can schedule background work before the user finishes setup.
findings.fix: Seed each new starter as paused=true and requires_approval=true. Do not auto-resume at wizard completion. Existing jobs retain their persisted paused/enabled state; reconciliation and Reset to default update recipe content/metadata only. User Resume in Automate clears approval. Hide or disable Run Now for approval-pending starters so the visible action matches the scheduler gate.
findings.acceptance: Under a temporary home with wizard_complete absent, every new starter is visible in Automate as PAUSED and cannot fire by cron, catch-up, or run-now. Completing the wizard alone leaves them paused. A user Resume enables exactly the selected starter, surviving restart and recipe reconciliation. Previously enabled, paused, and deleted starters retain those respective choices across upgrade. A failed/no-provider run reports failure without falsely claiming completion.

findings.issue: First-run wizard blocks chat until completion, while setup of local model and folders is UI-driven. The chat agent cannot itself lead the entire blank-machine setup path as requested.
findings.fix: Provide a minimal first-run chat/setup controller and delegated, permission-aware install/download/config tools with observable progress and resumable failure states; retain an offline/manual route when no inference engine exists.
findings.acceptance: On a clean user profile with neither Ollama nor a model, ask chat agent to set up local inference, folders, Tailscale, and computer control. Verify each action against OS/app state; make denied permission, unavailable network, download failure, and restart truthfully recoverable.

findings.issue: Computer control is macOS Accessibility-only, defaults off, and offers status, app listing, accessibility tree, click, and type actions, without general screenshot, scroll, or keyboard-shortcut primitives. Agent-led setup cannot assume control is usable on a fresh install.

findings.acceptance: Fresh macOS profile: denied Accessibility permission yields clear blocked status; after granting it, agent observes target app, navigates, clicks and types, detects a changed UI, and reports actual result. Test unsupported platform response separately.
